purpose: Reconstruction evidence for the two Linux build copies previously described as unreconstructible in SCORING.md. Both copies ARE reconstructible from committed materials; each recorded build-record.json source hash is reproduced exactly below. Reconstructed 2026-10-11 from branch obv/fl-next-decisions-comparison-r1 at commit a929eeb; pristine inputs are byte-identical to the run-time blobs (verified against commit 85a5bb3, the fixture-freeze commit in effect during the run).
correction: The earlier SCORING.md wording was wrong in two ways: (1) the os-module Logger shim is applied ONLY to ConfidenceLearningService.swift, by preprocess_learner.py; RecipeRepository.swift is staged verbatim by run.sh and receives a separate one-line sed that spells out CharacterSet.whitespacesAndNewlines (a Linux Foundation type-inference workaround). (2) Neither transform is lost: both scripts are committed.

reconstructions.method: preprocess_learner.py (committed logging-only preprocessor): strips the `import os` line, drops `, privacy: .public)` argument lists, prepends the no-op Logger shim block. Purely mechanical; the service body is untouched.

Staged verbatim by run.sh (no Logger shim; the file has no `import os` and no Logger usage), then the run.sh sed rewrites every `.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)` to the explicit type: s/trimmingCharacters(in: \.whitespacesAndNewlines)/trimmingCharacters(in: CharacterSet.whitespacesAndNewlines)/g (5 occurrences).
reconstructions.command: git cat-file blob 63cfbd2e3367c01429b29b0f249192805c126c66 | sed 's/trimmingCharacters(in: \.whitespacesAndNewlines)/trimmingCharacters(in: CharacterSet.whitespacesAndNewlines)/g' | sha256sum

scope_note: This reconstruction changes no run artifact: the frozen inputs (cases.jsonl, labels.jsonl, requests.jsonl, replay.json), the recorded Swift arm outputs, the synthetic mapped-proxy naming, and the grouped bootstrap intervals are all untouched. The build-record.json source hashes were already correct; only the prose in SCORING.md mischaracterized them.
caveat: The shimmed ConfidenceLearningService copy and the sed'd RecipeRepository copy remain unretained as files (the run.sh build directory was under /tmp); the evidence here is the exact byte-level reproduction of their hashes from committed inputs. An earlier independent reconstruction attempt also reproduced the ConfidenceLearningService hash; this record is the retained, reproducible form of both.
